author: Swinhoe, 1860
habitat: 침엽수림 속 흙 언덕, 낙엽활엽수림 속 언덕
summary: 봄과 가을에 전국을 지나가는 나그네새로, 침엽수림 속 흙 언덕의 깊은 구멍이나 낙엽활엽수림 속 언덕에서 지낸다. 암수가 함께 다니는 일이 많고, 이동할 때에도 무리를 이루지 않는다. 곤충을 주로 먹으며, 6월경에 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 국외에서는 구북구 동부, 사할린, 우수리, 쿠릴 열도, 홋카이도, 혼슈, 만주에 분포한다.

art.subject: Pale-legged Leaf Warbler (Phylloscopus tenellipes), adult on passage (sexes alike): crown greyish olive-brown, darker and greyer than the back; a long white to creamy-white supercilium; a dark olive eye-stripe; ear-coverts mottled buffy-white and dark olive; upperparts greenish olive-brown, the rump and uppertail coverts slightly warmer and rufous-tinged; wings with one or two thin whitish wing-bars; tail dark brown with greenish olive-brown outer edges; underparts white with a greyish-buff wash on the flanks; bill dark with a pale pinkish base to the lower mandible; dark brown eye; pale flesh-pink legs.
art.pose: perched low on a twig beside an earthen bank, side view
art.scene: Korean deciduous broadleaf woodland with an earthen bank during spring or autumn passage; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched low on a twig: greyer, darker crown, long white supercilium over a dark eye-stripe, greenish olive-brown back, rufous-tinged rump, thin pale wing-bars, white underparts, pale pink legs
adult, head in profile: white to creamy-white supercilium, dark olive eye-stripe, ear-coverts mottled buffy-white and dark olive, crown darker than the back, bill with a pale pinkish base below
art.build: Small, compact leaf warbler, 12cm — slimmer than a sparrow, with a fairly short tail and a rather large head. Bill fine and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs conspicuously pale pink to pale flesh-brown. Wings short and pointed. Forages low in shady undergrowth and on the ground in woodland, and habitually dips its tail downward as it moves.
avoid: Do not paint dark legs; the pale pink legs are this species' key mark.
Do not paint green-and-yellow tones like Arctic or Eastern Crowned Warbler; it is cold olive-brown above and white below.
Do not add a pale central crown stripe (Eastern Crowned Warbler).
